items.title: 구찌, 글로벌 앰버서더에 박보검 선정
items.summary: Korean trade press confirms Gucci's November 5 announcement naming actor Park Bo-gum as global brand ambassador, framed as part of creative director Demna's push to build fresh cultural relevance for the house in the Korean market.

items.title: 박보검, 구찌 글로벌 앰버서더 발탁
items.summary: Fashion outlet coverage of the ambassador news, describing Park Bo-gum's shift toward a more mature, rebellious styling direction in the campaign photos released alongside the announcement.

items.title: パク・ボゴム、グローバルブランド「グッチ」のアンバサダーに起用
items.summary: Japanese-language syndication of the Park Bo-gum ambassador news reaching Japanese K-pop/K-drama fan audiences, noting the appointment folds him into Gucci's various global events and projects.

items.title: 「グッチ ビューティ」が新パウダーを発売 色補正効果とツヤ感が叶う
items.summary: Gucci Beauty is launching a three-shade color-correcting "Gucci Glow" finishing powder (JPY 9,570) set for January 2027 release, with shades addressing sallowness, redness and dullness in an ivory-and-gold compact bearing the house's diamond motif.

items.title: グッチの新型バッグ「グッチ NY トートバッグ」が登場！伊勢丹新宿店で「GucciCore」ポップアップを開催
items.summary: Gucci opened a GucciCore pop-up at Isetan Shinjuku (Nov 4-10) tied to the 2027 Cruise collection referencing New York style, debuting a new NY Tote Bag with a Japan-exclusive small size priced at JPY 346,500.

items.title: 구찌·에르메스 고전하는데…'코치'에 지갑 여는 젊은 소비자들
items.summary: Critical-angle piece reporting Coach grew sales 16% (China +43%) in its latest quarter even as Kering and LVMH houses including Gucci and Hermès struggle, attributing the shift to consumer fatigue from steep luxury price hikes and Coach's more accessible $200-500 price band.

items.title: "버킨백 사두면 무조건 돈 번다더니"…에르메스의 굴욕
items.summary: Competitor-angle report that Hermès Birkin 25 resale premiums have fallen from 160% to 70% above retail as secondary-market Birkin/Kelly inventory has grown 6-7x versus pre-pandemic, illustrating a broader resale-market cooling relevant to Gucci's own category.

items.title: 賛否両論のデムナの「グッチ」は10点満点中の何点？業界アナリストが辛口リポート
items.summary: Bernstein analyst Luca Solca scored Demna's Gucci FW26-27 debut 7.6/10 using AI-assisted sentiment analysis, calling it 'progress in the right direction' but not a home run; critics singled out leggings and called shoes/bags 'boring' versus higher-scoring debuts from Dior and Chanel. Older piece resurfaced in ongoing critical discourse; retained for context only, not counted as fresh news.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀、关店105家、中国制造，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo explainer-style post summarizing Gucci's recent turbulence for Chinese audiences: Demna's runway debut, 105 global store closures, and the brand's first China-made sneakers, framed as a structural-adjustment narrative rather than a recovery story.

items.title: 古驰最近有什么大新闻？Demna首秀+关店105家+降价40%，3个维度说清+FAQ
items.summary: Weibo post detailing Gucci's price cuts in China of up to 40% on items like the Ophidia mini bucket bag (RMB 12,300 to 8,700), presented alongside store-closure and leadership-change context as evidence of aggressive repositioning.

items.title: 李旻浩、宁艺卓、朴宝剑携手GUCCI登W Korea2026年11月封面
items.summary: Weibo post covering the W Korea November 2026 cover featuring Gucci ambassadors Lee Min-ho, Ningning and newly-announced Park Bo-gum together, read by Chinese fans as confirmation of Gucci's deepened K-celebrity ambassador strategy across NEA.

items.title: 开云任命Demna为古驰新任艺术总监 - 讨论
items.summary: Zhihu discussion thread revisiting the Demna appointment, with commenters split roughly evenly between praising his Balenciaga-honed commercial instincts and warning his street-driven aesthetic clashes with Gucci's historically ornate, classic identity -- described by one commenter as risking 'destroying the classics' versus being 'a stroke of genius'.

items.title: 더쿠 - [다시, 보기] 구찌는 왜 경복궁을 고집했나…역설의 배설
items.summary: Korean community retrospective/critical thread questioning Gucci's past insistence on using Gyeongbokgung Palace for shows, with commenters debating whether the brand's heritage-borrowing marketing tactic feels exploitative versus genuinely collaborative with Korean culture.

items.title: 구찌 시계 장단점(인증) - 시계 갤러리
items.summary: DC Inside watch-gallery user review of Gucci watches concluding the brand offers design appeal and recognizability but lags rivals at the same price point on finishing quality and movement -- a quality-complaint style critical community data point; undated post, included as representative ongoing community sentiment.

items.title: 롤렉스 시계·에르메스 백, 리셀가격 급락
items.summary: Older but repeatedly cited background piece on luxury resale price drops across Rolex watches and Hermès bags; retained only as corroborating context for the resale-cooling theme surfaced in today's fresher Hankyung Birkin story, not counted toward freshness quota.

dry: Xiaohongshu (RED) (only evergreen product UGC surfaced, no dated Nov items)
Jing Daily (no fresh Nov 9 item beyond previously pooled Oct 30 piece)
